facts.text: I asked for an email that motivates people to implement good habits and practices for fitness.
I asked to avoid alternatives and to focus on email 1 in an outline, which I said is technically email 2 for me.
I wanted the email to be a deep dive on implementing good habits and practices to get fit.
I wanted the email to discourage doing nothing with the information and to discourage chasing the next diet, meal plan, or 5 lb weight loss.
I wanted the email to emphasize that the quick fix diets work based on calorie deficit.
I said most people are extreme in deficit and that it is impractical and hard to sustain.
I asked for a PS for the email that hints at the next email.
I specified the next email title as "Don't Let These Habits Sabotage Your Weight Loss Journey".
I asked that the next email include the top 3 most common and top 3 most uncommonly known weight loss habits.
I asked that the next email avoid referencing their specific results.
I asked for the PS and the next email in this sequence.
I asked to rewrite the content to focus on the least commonly known habits instead of the 3 least common habits.
I asked for another rewrite where 3 items are the least commonly known habits and the same applies to the email.
I asked for a rewrite where the 3 items are the least commonly known habits about energy balance and calorie deficit being the most important factor.
I asked to hint that the following email would pertain to NEAT and getting enough steps and activity.
I asked to create curiosity and intrigue without it seeming theatrical.
I asked to rewrite only the pasted text below.
I asked that the rewrite include 3 least commonly known points about energy balance and calorie deficit being the most important factor.
I asked to hint at the next email coming while focusing on NEAT and getting enough steps and activity.
I asked not to rewrite the PS from email 2.
I asked not to start writing email 4 yet.
